annotations.text:
AegisDraft — Tauri desktop shell.
Meta palette: #0064E0 primary, #1C2B33 ink, #F5F7F9 rails; the #0082FB / #A033FF / #FF5C01 / #FFC800 family is reserved for meaning — blue = internal match, orange = web, purple = AI writing, yellow = continuity.
Type: Hanken Grotesk (chrome) / Literata (manuscript) / IBM Plex Mono (agent log and model tags).

No cloud model path exists anywhere in this UI. Web similarity is the single opt-in network switch, and it is off by default.
Sample manuscript, word counts and scores are placeholder data for the prototype.

Three project types on one shell: a Deep Research session that fills the Library, and the Library feeding both a paper and a technical book.
Deep Research is the one part of the product that needs the network. The design keeps the promise narrow: only the generated questions are sent, never the manuscript; the domain list is visible; every request is logged to research-trace.json; reading, embedding and drafting all still happen locally.
Bibliography entries are real, widely-known papers used as sample data. Every score, percentage, word count and file path is invented.
